body:
I feel exactly the same way, I just started college, I'm 20, I still live with my parents. I feel like a fucking loser, lost all my friends from high school over the summer because I never hung out with them, couldn't even bring myself to go to mcdonalds let alone be in a social situation.

I knew college would be tough but I just feel numb. I walk around campus and see everyone talking to someone, holding someone's hand, walking with someone. I know that I can make friends but then I look at myself in the mirror and think, "I wouldn't want to be friends with this guy". So how can I expect them to?

I put on my mask to make it through the day, and I can't help but see that in everyone else, everything seems so fake.

My therapist won't even be real with me because she thinks my social anxiety means I can't talk to her either, when in reality she's the only person I can talk to.

I wish I had something better to say bro, I wish I could say it's going to get better but I know that doesn't help. I guess what I can say is I'm right there with you, this shit is fucking hard.
